title: Background Check Recency and Temporary License Acceptance on Wayfare Driver Agreements
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing.** How recent a Wayfare driver's latest clear background check is bears on the temporary license acceptance days, the calendar days from the upload day for which a paper temporary driver's license is accepted as the driver's license on file.

## Rule

When the latest clear background check on the agreement is dated fewer than 180 calendar days before the upload day, the temporary license acceptance days gain 6 days; when it is dated at least 180 but fewer than 365 days before, they gain 3 days; when it is dated 365 days or more before, they gain none.

The date read is the background check date on the agreement, which is the date of the latest clear background check.

## Decision table

| Background check date, counted back from the upload day | Days gained |
|---|---|
| 0 to 179 days before | 6 |
| 180 to 364 days before | 3 |
| 365 days or more before | 0 |

## Edges (hypothetical, upload day 2026-08-10)

| Background check date | Days before the upload day | Days gained |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-02-12 | 179 | 6 |
| 2026-02-11 | 180 | 3 |
| 2025-08-11 | 364 | 3 |
| 2025-08-10 | 365 | 0 |
